messages:
sara (HW PM): Quick heads-up — SparrowBoard folks want a focused run tomorrow 10am PT to validate thermal headroom + kernel tuning for perf/W on long-seq throughput. Can we assemble reproducer + telemetry?

michael (Infra Eng): I can package a reproducer. question: do they want fan-curve control or just passive thermal?

clara (Partner Eng): They can control fan curve, but prefer we provide a minimal docker repro so they can run overnight. They'll also share raw board logs.

raj (Runtime Eng): For kernel flags, biggest candidates: async_io patch, L2_PREFETCH toggle, and cpuset pinning. I have a small runner that toggles kvcache prefetch and records p50/p99 + power.

sara (HW PM): Perfect. action: michael + raj to produce docker + run script by EOD. partner needs it to start a smoke overnight.

michael (Infra Eng): Will do. I'll push image to gcr and paste link here when done. Expect ~30m.

bench-bot: Artifact uploaded: gcr.io/redwood-bench/thermal-repro:sha256-abc123def (size: 248MB)

raj (Runtime Eng): Note from local smoke: async_io gave ~6% perf/W on 4k seq when fan at 70%. But short-seq latency (<=128) regressed ~2-3ms — we should guard with canary policy.

clara (Partner Eng): Sharing telemetry schema & fan profile: https://redwood.internal/s/bench/telemetry-schema.csv and attached fan_profile.json on partner side.

sara (HW PM): Plan for call: partner runs thermal burn, we run latency/throughput sweep. Raj monitors kvcache/prefetch toggles and posts perf/W every 15m. If we see >5% perf/W improvement without >5% latency regression on short seqs, escalate to joint announcement prep.

michael (Infra Eng): I'll open INF Jira and link artifacts + results. JIRA: INF-7024

sara (HW PM): Thanks — I'll ping partner to confirm 10am and share the call link. :thumbsup:

clara (Partner Eng): Confirmed on our side. We'll capture thermal telemetry and attach logs to the Jira when done.

michael (Infra Eng): Docker link: gcr.io/redwood-bench/thermal-repro:sha256-abc123def

raj (Runtime Eng): Added the quick run command to the image README: `./run_bench.sh --seq 4096 --duration 30m --kv-prefetch={on,off}`.

sara (HW PM): Great. See you all tomorrow.
